$comment: Every skill and agent in the kit, its group, and the install profiles. The installer reads this; `agent-setup lint` checks it against kit/skills and kit/agents. Profiles list skill names or @group; the `core` list is always installed. Which skills are vendored (rebuilt from upstream, never hand-edited) is recorded in kit/vendor.json, not here.

groups.domain: Engineering expertise, written for this kit: loads when the work matches the domain
groups.core: The delivery workflow and the learning loop — installed in every project
groups.design: Visual design direction, brand references and real-browser verification, sequenced by frontend-design-workflow — opt-in

frontend.summary: UI components, pages, forms, client/server state, accessibility, frontend performance and tests

backend.summary: Domain logic, persistence, migrations, transactions, concurrency, jobs, caching, observability

api-design.summary: The middle layer: HTTP/GraphQL/gRPC contracts, BFFs, middleware, webhooks, third-party integrations

security.summary: Threat modelling, secure implementation, and security review of a change

architecture.summary: Boundaries, dependency rules, trade-off decisions and ADRs

design-system.summary: Tokens, theming, shared components, and the checks that keep UI on-system

agent-eval.summary: Evals for prompts, agents, LLM features and skills; baselines and regression gates

self-improve.summary: Capture lessons, route them to where they are enforced, export kit improvements

sdlc-init.summary: Survey the repo; write its SDLC contract, knowledge base, overlays and gap register

gates.summary: Run the repo's gates exactly as CI does, cheapest first, and report PASS/FAIL

ship-it.summary: Commit and open a PR the way this repo expects — never into production uninvited

handoff.summary: Write a precise handoff so the next session continues without re-deriving context

enforcement-audit.summary: Audit what the repo claims against what it enforces; ranked gap register

frontend-design-workflow.summary: Entry point for visual design work: checks the environment, sizes the task, runs the design pipeline, settles conflicts

design-md-library.summary: 74 brand DESIGN.md systems (Linear, Stripe, Vercel…) adapted into the project, never cloned

design-taste-frontend.summary: Default design build skill: brief inference, design dials, anti-slop rules, pre-flight check

gpt-taste.summary: Design build skill for GPT-family models on motion-heavy briefs

image-to-code.summary: Image-first build when the agent can generate images: comps first, then code

imagegen-frontend-web.summary: Website design comps as images, one per section (no code)

imagegen-frontend-mobile.summary: Mobile app screen concepts and flows as images (no code)

brandkit.summary: Brand identity boards as images: logo directions, palettes, typography (no code)

redesign-existing-projects.summary: Audit checklist and fix order for upgrading an existing site's design

high-end-visual-design.summary: Style layer: soft, calm, premium (at most one style layer per project)

industrial-brutalist-ui.summary: Style layer: Swiss typography, terminal, raw

stitch-design-taste.summary: Writes the project's DESIGN.md so the design system persists across sessions and tools

full-output-enforcement.summary: Stops truncated output on large generations

web-design-guidelines.summary: Audits UI code against Vercel's Web Interface Guidelines

agent-browser.summary: Default real-browser verification: screenshots, theme emulation, console, axe audit

playwright-cli.summary: WebKit/Firefox checks, Playwright tests, tracing and live-page annotation

gate-runner.summary: Runs the gates in its own context and returns MERGE-SAFE or BLOCKED

security-reviewer.summary: Read-only security review of a diff; ranked, evidenced findings

architecture-reviewer.summary: Read-only boundary and dependency review of a change

docs-keeper.summary: Verifies .claude/docs claims against the tree and fixes drift

standard.description: Engineering skills and the delivery workflow (the default).

full.description: Every skill in the kit, including the design group.

web.description: Full-stack web product, with visual design.

frontend.description: Frontend app or site, with visual design.

ai-app.description: Product with LLM or agent features.
